            button = Button(self.window, text=buttons[i], command=lambda i=i: self.append_to_equation(buttons[i]))

    def append_to_equation(self, char):
        equation = self.equation.get()
        self.equation.set(equation + char)

    def calculate(self, event):
        equation = self.equation.get()
        try:
            result = eval(equation, {'__builtins__': None}, {})
            self.equation.set(str(result))
        except:
            self.equation.set('Invalid Expression')
